---
name: Tell me how you use it
about: No bug, no request. Just tell me how you use permdrift, or why you stopped
labels: question
---

This is for plain feedback. Short answers are fine, skip what you do not want to answer.

How many hosts do you run it on, and how do you run it (cron, CI, by hand)?

Where do you keep the baselines?

What do you do with the diff output? Read it, ticket it, feed it to something else?

Did anything surprise you or waste your time?

What made you look at permdrift instead of AIDE, osquery, Wazuh or something else, or are you using those too?
